description.value: Munro's Feed is a small farm supply business operated by Jane Munro in Clinton, British Columbia, in the heart of the Thompson Country. Run as a self-employed operation, it serves the local rural community along Dewdney Avenue. Cyclists passing through Clinton on Highway 97 or connecting routes may find it a landmark stop in this small ranching town.
